_note: v2.4 plan 03 live gate 4. Real model, so-scenario --sandbox --group 1759606632088, lanes only; cadence 99 so no cadence read competes. EXPANSION: the start anchor of live-v24-03-stub reaches a stub, so a /sendas boundary queues its chain; once the entry is generating with its request in flight, /newchat (adopted into the sandbox) switches away; the interrupted request is recorded (the epoch abort should reject it), then the run reopens the sandbox chat: the entry must not come back queued/generating, expansion.scheduler.inFlight must be false and the player line must not read 'Preparing the road ahead'. A new boundary must then re-generate the stub with no Regenerate click, and the chain must settle (any settled status; the model's chain may legitimately fail code checks) with the player line released. BACKLOG: 80 synthetic rows are seeded (the last a character row with two swipes), Memorize chat is started from the manager's drawer path (preflight answered if asked), and while one of its reads is in flight the last message is swiped (ST's swipe.to): backfill.running must go false without a reload, lastError must say the chat changed, and the drawer's Memorize chat button must be enabled; pressing it again starts a new run (then cancelled).
